 Shopee Q3/2026: What growth opportunities are there for small and niche sellers?
 VTV.vn - The growth in the number of new buyers and the total transaction value of sellers on Shopee in Q3/2026 shows that the e-commerce market still offers business opportunities.
 Đài truyền hình Việt Nam • 03/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 The growth in new buyers and total transaction value for sellers on Shopee in Q3 2026 shows that the e-commerce market still offers business opportunities, but to convert this growth potential into orders, sellers need to understand buyer needs correctly, choose the right channels, and improve operational efficiency. 
 In Q3 2026, the number of new users on Shopee increased by 70% year-on-year, while the total transaction value of sellers across the platform increased by 45%. The seller ecosystem also continued to expand, with an average of over 37,000 new sellers joining each month and more than 15 million new products listed for sale each month across the platform.
 In the context of the continuing growth of e-commerce, opportunities are not limited to large-scale industries or trend-setting products. The key is to correctly identify market needs and best meet them with the company's products and resources. The report "Growth Landscape and Business Dynamics of Shopee Sellers in Q3 2026" highlights notable trends and suggests strategies sellers can consider to prepare for the peak year-end shopping season.
 Escape the price war and create a competitive advantage through added value. 
 In a context where consumers are increasingly demanding and consider all aspects before making purchasing decisions, opportunities don't necessarily lie in the lowest-priced products, but also in those that address specific needs and provide clear value. This is evident in needs such as fast delivery, purchasing genuine products at reasonable prices, or seeking larger items that require more complex shipping arrangements.
 A representative from Bear Vietnam stated: "We've noticed that consumers are paying more attention to the quality, safety, and practical value of a product, rather than just the price as they did before." 
 As of Q3 2026, over 1 million sellers on Shopee supported express shipping for more than 44 million products; the number of orders using this method increased by 43% compared to the same period last year. Meanwhile, the total transaction value of bulky orders doubled compared to the same period, showing that specific needs can still open up business opportunities when shopping and delivery barriers are better addressed, giving users more choices.
 Another approach is to meet the demand for affordable shopping while still prioritizing quality. Following its launch in April 2026, the number of participating sellers in Shopee Mall Outlet tripled and the number of products sold increased eightfold in Q3 compared to Q2 2026.
 From these movements, sellers can review their product catalogs, build product packages that suit actual needs, or improve delivery options. Instead of applying a single strategy to all product categories, correctly identifying the product's advantages and the factors buyers value will help sellers choose a more appropriate competitive approach.

 Besides product demand, the way consumers discover and choose products is also creating more opportunities for sellers. In Q3 2026, the total number of orders through Shopee Live, Shopee Video , and Shopee Affiliate increased by 52% compared to the same period last year; Shopee Video alone recorded an increase of nearly 80%.
 A representative from the DELIZ brand shared: "In September, DELIZ's revenue from Shopee Live increased by nearly 40% compared to the previous month. This confirms that the trend of shopping combined with entertainment remains an important channel, opening up opportunities for fashion brands to reach customers more visually and effectively." 
 While display advertising brings products to new users, engaging content helps maintain interest, drive engagement, and encourage viewers to learn more about the product and brand, thereby expanding conversion opportunities. Depending on the industry and resources, sellers can combine livestreaming for direct consultations, short videos to explain product uses, or affiliate marketing to expand reach through content creators. It's not necessary to implement every method simultaneously; the important thing is to choose a presentation style that aligns with the product and the purchasing behavior of the target customer. 
 Market expansion opportunities are not limited to the domestic market. Through the Global Selling Program (SIP) and the Direct Selling model, Shopee supports domestic sellers in reaching buyers in Southeast Asia and Taiwan. By the end of Q3 2026, over 600,000 sellers had participated in these two models; the number of sellers participating in Direct Selling in Q3 alone increased fourfold compared to the same period last year.
 For retailers seeking new growth avenues, evaluating the potential of each channel and market will help expand customer reach without relying on a single source of orders.
 Requires minimal resources; builds trust through consistent operational quality and customer experience. 
 Customer trust is built from the very first touchpoints, through product information, store reputation, and consistently maintained business standards. Therefore, identifying the right needs and channels is part of the equation; maintaining operational quality as the business scales up is equally important.
 You may also like In Q3 2026, the number of sellers upgrading to Shopee Mall doubled compared to the same period last year, while the number of sellers achieving the Favorite Shop+ title increased by 73%. These are steps that help sellers strengthen their reputation and create a foundation for buyers to confidently choose products, even before directly experiencing them.
 Alongside building credibility, applying technology, especially AI , can support sellers in content production, experimenting with product presentation methods, and leveraging data to better understand customer needs. This allows for gradual personalization of the experience without necessarily increasing operational resources. In Q3 2026, the number of sellers using AI-powered livestreaming increased 28 times, the number of livestream sessions increased 45 times, and the number of orders from these sessions increased 21 times compared to the same period last year. 
 For small and niche retailers, the key is not to invest broadly or chase every new technology, but to choose solutions that suit their existing capabilities. When the store's reputation is strengthened and the technology is applied effectively, retailers can build trust with buyers while maintaining a consistent experience throughout their growth.
 For example, a representative from NutiFood stated: "In Q3/2026, NutiFood GrowPLUS+ proactively applied AI in livestreaming to expand customer reach, optimize operational resources, and thereby increase conversion opportunities. We predict that formats such as short videos, livestreaming, and personalized shopping experiences will continue to drive consumer purchases, while also requiring e-commerce brands to improve operational quality." 
 Entering Q4 2026, the e-commerce market will have significant growth potential, but there is no one-size-fits-all formula. Whether focusing on popular product categories or specialized segments, the ability to understand market demand, leverage product advantages, and allocate resources effectively will be key factors in helping sellers find opportunities and enhance their competitiveness during the peak year-end shopping season.
